lines.zh: 我把袖子挽起来，朝你走过来。
lines.en: I roll up my sleeves and walk toward you.

lines.zh: 脚步很稳，像在自家院子。
lines.en: My steps are steady, like in my own yard.
I cinch my apron without looking.
I do not run; I only walk faster.

lines.zh: 风吹起我的头发，我懒得理。
lines.en: The wind lifts my hair and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我在地上一踩，土都实了。
lines.en: I plant a foot and the soil packs down.
I read the terrain as I go.

lines.zh: 我走得比看上去快得多。
lines.en: I am faster than I look.

lines.zh: 地上有块石头，我一脚踢开。
lines.en: A stone is in my way, so I kick it aside.
I settle my breathing.
I have not been idle all these years.
I stand with a hand at my waist.
I stare at you with a frown.
I still have dinner to make.
I do not like wasting time.
Your stance is wrong.
I tuck my hair behind my ear.
I sigh, as if tired.

lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼太阳的位置。
lines.en: I check where the sun sits.
I want to be home before mealtime.
I shake out my wrists.

lines.zh: 我嘴里念着什么，像在算账。
lines.en: I mutter something, as if doing sums.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，就知道你练过。
lines.en: One look tells me you have trained.
Do not call me auntie.
Where are your eyes going?
Stand up straight when you speak.
I look you up and down.

lines.zh: 你这身衣服，打起来碍事。
lines.en: Those clothes will get in your way.
I am not someone to trifle with.
Your fist is too loose.
I raise an eyebrow.
Are you really going to fight me?

lines.zh: 别小看地球长大的战士。
lines.en: Don't underestimate a warrior raised on Earth.

lines.zh: 你脸上写着自信，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your face says confidence; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我把袖子又往上推了推。
lines.en: I push my sleeves up a bit more.
Do not think I came here to cook.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Take one step back and I will pretend I saw nothing.
Strength from housework is no small thing.

lines.zh: 你笑，我也笑，可我没在开玩笑。
lines.en: You smile, I smile, but I am not joking.
Want to test what I have practiced?
I grunt and give half a step.
I have taken worse than that.
My arm goes numb for a moment.
My clothes are torn; what a nuisance.
I wipe the blood from my lip.
My glare sharpens.
I steady my breath and reset my stance.
Do not think you have the upper hand.
Trying to coax me with food? Save it.

lines.zh: 这招对他管用，对我没用。
lines.en: That works on him, not on me.
I do not even look at it.
Do you think I am a child?
If you are hungry, go eat it yourself.
I push it back at you.

lines.zh: 我斜眼看着你手里的东西。
lines.en: I eye what you are holding.
We finish this first, then talk about food.

lines.zh: 你拿食物当武器，真没出息。
lines.en: Using food as a weapon; how pathetic.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我侧身就让开了。
lines.en: You charge and I simply step aside.
I shoulder you back.
You hit me and bounced off yourself.
I stand steadier than you think.
I raise an elbow to block.

lines.zh: 我们错身而过，谁都没让。
lines.en: We pass and neither gives way.
My feet leave two dents in the ground.
My bump sends you staggering.
Try it again and I will not be gentle.
I have to get home first.
My time is running short.

lines.zh: 我会把饭做好，等他回来。
lines.en: I will cook and wait for him to come home.
I have waited long enough all these years.
There is still a pile of things to do at home.

lines.zh: 我把手在围裙上擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my apron.
I straighten my collar.
Time to head back; it is getting dark.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，拍了拍土。
lines.en: I bend, pick it up, and brush off the dirt.
Leaving this here would be a waste.
I tuck it into my sleeve pocket.
We happen to need this at home.

lines.zh: 我看了看，值不了几个钱。
lines.en: I look it over; it is worth little.
You dropped it? I will hold it for you.
I shove it into my belt.
This thing is filthy.
I pick it up, then set it down.

lines.zh: 掉东西的人可要心疼了。
lines.en: Whoever dropped this will be upset.

lines.zh: 你刚才那一下，我看清了。
lines.en: I saw exactly what you did there.
I drop my center of gravity.
If you want a fight, we fight.
I will treat you as a training partner.
Your opening is obvious.

lines.zh: 我这把扇子，比气功还疼。
lines.en: My fan hurts worse than ki.
One.
Two.
I am not waiting for three.
Ki gathers in my palm.
You had better tighten your fists.
I told you not to provoke me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你移动，脚步不乱。
lines.en: I track your movement without breaking step.

lines.zh: 你出拳的节奏我摸清了。
lines.en: I have your punching rhythm now.
I raise a hand and stop the second blow.
I step in and you step back.
I wait for you to commit.
Every turn you make is half a beat late.
My ki is not spent yet.
I herd you toward the wall.
I see you looking for a way out.
I will give you no chance to rest.
I press forward another step.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，不是你的手。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your hands.
You slowed.
The time has come.
I gather ki into my fist.
One punch, square in your chest.
I kick the back of your knee to drop you.

lines.zh: 我的掌根撞在你下巴上。
lines.en: My palm heel snaps your jaw.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可我的力道透过去。
lines.en: You block, but the force passes through.
I catch your wrist and twist.
I drive a knee into your stomach.

lines.zh: 气顺着拳头进了你的身体。
lines.en: Ki follows my fist into you.
You cannot even stand straight.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
I have ten more of those in me.
You made a mistake.
This palm will teach you manners.
I hear your ribs.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，门都没关。
lines.en: I step out of the house, leaving the door open.
I came wearing my apron.
This place is quieter than I expected.

lines.zh: 我把手在衣服上擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my clothes.
The pot is still on the fire.
Someone sent for me, so I came.
I scan the area and find you.
I roll up my sleeves and get to work.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，没打算客气。
lines.en: I stand in the doorway with no mind to be polite.
I sigh, not loudly.
I smooth my hair.
No cooking today.
I pull my belt tight.
There is a smell of gunpowder in the air.
I am here; do not dawdle.
I clench my fist until the knuckles whiten.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我赶紧拍掉。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，落地滚了一圈。
lines.en: I fall from a height and roll on landing.

lines.zh: 我呛了一口水，拼命往上游。
lines.en: I choke on water and kick for the surface.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我撑着地爬起来。
lines.en: The blast throws me and I push myself up.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩膀，我咬牙拔掉。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder and I yank it out.

lines.zh: 咒光打在我身上，火辣辣的。
lines.en: Spell-light hits me and it stings.

lines.zh: 我一天没吃饭了，力气见底。
lines.en: I have not eaten all day and my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 雷击穿我的身体，我跪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me and I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有着力点，我抓不住。
lines.en: There is nothing to grip in the void.
